theorems.name: Submission.fiw_tb_restrictDomain_mass_im
theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U W : Set (Eucl P)) (hWU : W ⊆ U), IsOpen W → ∀ Y : GeometricCurrentOn U k, (Y.restrictDomain hWU).mass ≤ Y.mass ∧ (IsIntegerMultiplicity Y → IsIntegerMultiplicity (Y.restrictDomain hWU))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
